payload.body: RULE -> MAIL: owner said 'làm cả 2' in my window. (1) Removed key crossSessionInbound from ~/.claude/settings.json; backup ~/.fgos/private/upgrade-act-261106/claude-settings.json.pre-accept-removal. (2) Shared checkout cannot pull (local uncommitted .claude/settings.json, .fgos/config.yaml, AGENTS.md overlap main), so I set eventStore.sync.intervalSec 60 with fgos config set (same value and why as main 281b25a61; backup config.yaml.pre-interval), then ran doctor --fix. Timer: mailbox-sync-timer passed 'takes mail every 60 s'; unit has OnBootSec=60, OnUnitActiveSec=60. IMPORTANT FINDING: doctor --fix re-wrote crossSessionInbound: accept into ~/.claude/settings.json (mtime 17:37:56, key appended, permissions block re-indented) — the same fix undoes the removal, so my two orders collided. I removed the key again by hand; final state: key absent, row mailbox-claude-accept red (intended: 'does not accept cross-session input'). Any future doctor --fix on fg-server will re-add it; that needs a decision on your side (the row's fix versus the owner's wish to keep it off). cher (scoped) untouched.
